label: def:motivic-substrate
title: The motivic substrate $(K_0(\mathrm{Var}_k), \mathbb{L}, \{\rho_v\})$
html:
The QOU framework's algebraic substrate appears through two faces: the Frobenius–Hopf substrate and the adelic substrate. Both realize a single underlying object: the motivic substrate, a Grothendieck-ring datum equipped with a tower of realization functors.

Definition (motivic substrate, axiom). The motivic substrate of the QOU framework is the triple

  \mathcal{S}_{\mathrm{mot}}
  \;:=\;
  \bigl(K_0(\mathrm{Var}_k),\; \mathbb{L},\; \{\rho_v\}_{v \in \mathrm{Pl}(\mathbb{Q})}\bigr),

consisting of:

  1. the Grothendieck ring of varieties K_0(\mathrm{Var}_k) over the base field k. It is the free abelian group on isomorphism classes [X] of k-varieties modulo the scissor relations [X] = [Z] + [X \setminus Z] for closed Z \subseteq X, with product [X] \cdot [Y] = [X \times_k Y].
  2. the Lefschetz motive \mathbb{L} := [\mathbb{A}^1_k] \in K_0(\mathrm{Var}_k), with the localized ring \mathcal{M} := K_0(\mathrm{Var}_k)[\mathbb{L}^{-1}] and its dimension-completion \widehat{\mathcal{M}} (motivic mass measure).
  3. a realization tower \{\rho_v \colon \widehat{\mathcal{M}} \to \widehat{\mathcal{M}}_v\}. We assign one realization functor per place v of \mathbb{Q} (adelic substrate). The archimedean realization \rho_\infty is the archimedean realization functor, landing in \mathbb{R}. The non-archimedean realizations \rho_p at a finite prime p produce local cyclotomic data compatible with the Habiro-ring framework (Habiro completion).

The motivic substrate is taken axiomatically: the ring K_0(\mathrm{Var}_k), the Lefschetz class \mathbb{L}, the localization \widehat{\mathcal{M}}, and the realization functors are posited as given data, and every downstream construction is stated conditionally on this substrate.
